title: Source-neutral interpretation and reconstruction workflow: any source in, neutral JSON out, any target rebuilds per JSON instruction
summary: A workflow rule generalizing how external sources (hand sketch, SketchUp model, any tool) enter USG as a neutral interpretation JSON and are reconstructed in any downstream software from the same JSON instruction. Demonstrated end to end on 2026-10-26/27: hand sketch -> Building_001_Neutral_Spec_v0.2.json -> STL -> Blender, passing the spec's own acceptance checks in a non-BIM target.

proposed_rule.statement: The neutral interpretation file is the contract, not the source. Any source that can be interpreted into the USG neutral hand-off format, and any target that can map out of it, are interchangeable. Acceptance invariants are target-independent: the same checks must pass identically whether the target is Revit, Blender, IFC or another reconstruction engine.

pipeline.does: Carries facts. A hand sketch is sparse on geometry, rich in annotation. A SketchUp model is the opposite: exact geometry, missing semantics. Other sources sit anywhere between.
Interprets the source into a neutral JSON: purpose, constraints, evidence states, nulls for unknowns. Asks the user only questions that block a coherent decision.
Emits descent premises, build_policy (build / record_only / ignore, with an explicit approximate_policy), and target-independent acceptance invariants. pending_user blocks binding downstream output.

pipeline.actor: target mapper (ARPL/Revit, Blender, IFC exporter, other)
pipeline.does: Maps neutral objects to native objects. Preserves identifiers, evidence states, nulls and relationships. Invents no values USG left null; a null must still be null after mapping.
Verifies the target-independent invariants with read-back evidence and returns a per-invariant pass/fail report. API success alone is never completion.

evidence_asymmetry.hand_sketch: Interpretation effort is in classifying evidence: dimensioned vs proportional vs observed. Dimensions override proportion; proportion fills the gaps; user clarification resolves contradictions.
evidence_asymmetry.sketchup_model: All geometry is exact (the model is the dimension) but semantics are missing. Interpretation effort is in recovering intent, not measuring.

exact: vertex coordinates (model internal unit is inches; must be converted and the unit declared)
observed: semantic roles: which face groups are walls, floors or roofs
which components represent doors, windows or furniture
unknown_stays_null: wall thickness (surface modeler: walls are often single faces)

hand_off_contract_essentials.descent_premises: Premises USG relied on when descending. Downstream evidence contradicting one of them is the only trigger for upstream correction; all other failures stay local (thin upstream loop).
hand_off_contract_essentials.build_policy: build / record_only / ignore, plus approximate_policy: 'excluded' (approximate values quarantined, Building 001 v0.2 rule) or 'labeled' (approximates may be built, always flagged). The choice is declared per handoff so downstream never guesses.
hand_off_contract_essentials.acceptance: Target-independent invariants plus policy checks (nulls preserved, no invented binding values, identifiers and evidence preserved), satisfied only by a pass/fail report with read-back evidence.

worked_examples.source: Hand sketch dated 2026-10-26 (plan and perspective on one sheet)
worked_examples.interpretation: Building_001_Neutral_Spec_v0.2.json: six evidence kinds, quarantined proportional hints, 132.0 m2 footprint, validation section as acceptance invariants

targets.result: Watertight prism, 20 facets, closed manifold; spec acceptance checks V001-V006 passed in the target (area 132.0 m2, volume 356.4 m3 = 132 x 2.7 m)
targets.notes: Extrusion height 2700 mm declared a convention, not from the source; proportional hints excluded under the v0.2 rule

targets.result: Proposal only; makes approximate_policy explicit so the Building 001 v0.2 rule (excluded) and the architectural sketch proposal (labeled) coexist as declared governance choices

open_questions_for_curator: Adopt one approximate_policy for the protocol, or keep it a per-handoff declared choice?
Should source adapters (sketch interpreter, SketchUp extractor) become a named USG stage or stay external to the protocol?
Does the SketchUp evidence classification above belong in docs/proposals/architectural-sketch-reconstruction.md?
